subject: cyborgMedic
pitch:
Category: Humanoid character.
Subject: support-hero cyborg medic with a healing staff.
Style: Overwatch.
reasoning:
The rendered character's pose appears stiff and unnatural, especially the legs, which are overly straight and rigid, hindering the desired agile Overwatch aesthetic. The arms also contribute to the rigid appearance. This straight and stiff pose makes the model look less dynamic and heroic.


Wings and torso lack Overwatch stylistic elements, appearing more like static appendages than dynamic components. The legs are oversized columns, devoid of cybernetic detail, and the staff's pose lacks dynamism. The head presents a plain silhouette, needing distinct Overwatch helmet features for a more iconic design.


The wings require a complete overhaul, shifting from simple spars to an articulated design with overlapping hardlight feather blades for a dynamic silhouette. The color palette needs adjustment, incorporating prominent pearl white armor contrasting with dark undersuit, gold accents, and vibrant photonic/medical highlights. The staff should be enlarged and enhanced with rotating elements, a central biotic core, and golden accents. Heroic poses are necessary, requiring a hip tilt and wider, more natural leg stance, adjusting foot positions to achieve a dynamic "A" stance.


A slight knee flex will be applied to the legs for a more natural stance using inverse kinematics. The left arm will be raised, bent, and open, projecting a medical sigil, while the right arm will hold the staff at an angle. The head will have a slight, confident tilt. The wing positioning will be adjusted, angling them upwards and outwards for a more heroic silhouette, incorporating articulated mechanical arms with hardlight feather blades in cyan/teal.


Armor design will adhere to Overwatch's visual language: clean, chunky shapes with beveled edges and high-contrast accents. White ceramic armor will define the character, with segmented abdomen plating and layered shoulder pauldrons. Futuristic boots with shin guards, ankle discs, and cyan sole runners are essential for the overall look.

The helmet will feature a pearlescent white crown, angled gold brow, and glowing cyan accents. Instead of a simple cylinder, the face requires a distinct visor, porcelain chin, rebreather vents, and cybernetic temple plugs. A cybernetic ponytail or antennae will complete the head design. The staff will be a carbon fiber shaft with gold ferrules, cyan conduit lines, and a wrapped grip.


The staff design will incorporate a central biotic energy sphere framed by articulated caduceus wings with a rotating stabilizer halo. Double-helix biotic laser coils will be wound along the staff's upper section, projecting a holographic medical cross from the tip. The base needs to be updated to function as an Overwatch healing pad, featuring an octagonal rim, recessed metallic floor, a biotic cross symbol, and energy emitters.

Dedicated SVG assets will need to be developed for the biotic emblem, visor HUD, staff halo, base capture point graphic, and sponsor decals. The current part, triangle, joint, and color counts are well within the program's specified limits, and the file structure needs to be comprehensively rewritten to effectively implement these significant changes.


Precise geometric coordinates are being calculated to define the medic's pose, ensuring a height of approximately 1.85m (1.9m with helmet), incorporating a slight arch in the spine, and positioning the feet in a dynamic "A" stance. The left arm will be raised with a bent elbow, casting a biotic sphere, while the right arm holds the staff. The staff's coordinates are set to point it forward and slightly outwards, with the ferrule near the floor.


Staff positioning is finalized with the head at the calculated coordinate, orienting the caduceus head prominently to catch light without obscuring character features. Wing base and mechanical pylon coordinates are now defined, including feather blade positions and dimensions to create a dynamic, iconic wing silhouette. The color scheme is being implemented, focusing on white ceramic armor and dark undersuit with gold and cyan accents.
